page: Google Cloud Platform n2-standard-64 is a general-purpose virtual machine offering a balanced resource profile for multi-threaded enterprise workloads. Powered by an x86_64 Intel Xeon processor operating at 2.8 GHz, the instance delivers 64 dedicated vCPUs mapped across 32 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled. The CPU cache architecture comprises 32 KB of L1 data cache, 1.0 MB of L2 cache, and a shared 33 MB L3 cache, backed by instruction sets including AVX-512, AVX-512 VNNI, and AES hardware acceleration. The configuration provides 256.0 GB of system memory, maintaining a standard 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio of 4.0 GB per virtual core.

The instance includes no bundled local storage and features zero GPUs, requiring network-attached storage for persistence and limiting its utility for hardware-accelerated machine learning workloads. Performance benchmarks reveal strong memory throughput, achieving 268.78 GB/sec in large-block read operations and 131.67 GB/sec in write operations, placing memory bandwidth in the top 25 percent. In compute benchmarks, the instance registered 14,944.0 on Geekbench multi-core and demonstrated strong capability in software compilation tasks, scoring 40,304.0 in Clang build tests, alongside a strong PassMark database operations result of 22,557.31.

While synthetic CPU stress tests and web serving throughput align with median general-purpose tiers, the high sustained memory bandwidth provides favorable resource efficiency for data manipulation and large compilation jobs without requiring memory-optimized pricing tiers. Large-model LLM generation is constrained on pure CPU execution, as shown by 2.67 tokens per second on 70B models. Consequently, the n2-standard-64 is suited for large-scale enterprise applications, distributed compilation pipelines, medium-to-large relational databases, caching tiers, and multi-tenant web application backends.
description: Google Cloud Platform n2-standard-64 is a general-purpose compute instance equipped with 64 dedicated vCPUs across 32 physical Intel Xeon cores at 2.8 GHz and 256.0 GB of RAM. Operating on an x86_64 architecture with support for AVX-512 extensions, it maintains a standard 4.0 GB memory-to-core allocation. The instance contains zero GPUs and relies on external persistent storage, as no local storage is included. Benchmark evaluations indicate strong memory subsystem performance, highlighted by 268.78 GB/sec in uncached block reads and strong scores in PassMark database operations and Clang code compilation. General CPU stress and web serving benchmarks place the instance in the middle tier, while CPU-bound large language model generation reveals performance trade-offs inherent to non-accelerated hardware. The n2-standard-64 provides solid resource density for multi-threaded workloads, making it well matched for enterprise application hosting, medium-scale database workloads, continuous integration build clusters, and in-memory analytics.
